E0Policy: The retained56E0 profiles remain E0 regardless of current fingerprint changes. Only the four exact E0 baseline profiles replaced by genuine paired whole-profile selections become E1; any additional existing explicit wholeP acceptance must first be pinned against exact current whole-profile bytes. E0/G0 is allowed by v2 and is not itself a stock P-ready or M7 blocker; do not infer a content HOLD from that label.
machineClaimBoundary: AI candidates stay needs_human_review. E1/G1 denotes the selected scientific profile evidence, not learner performance, official source completion, Human Approval or M7.

futureExecution.condition: All exact canonical visualization bytes are installed at app/public URLs, and measured fingerprints/assets are reverified. This plan does not execute the stock writer.
futureExecution.concatPolicy: After all namespace outputs pass the unchanged stock reviewer, merge by selectedWriterInput goal order into P442.review.jsonl. Never concatenate duplicate old scopes blindly.

centralConfigRoutingRequirement.reason: Stock reportDeepUnderstandingRollout requires exact config path equality as well as current fingerprints. All126 scopes are disjoint; the merged P442 ledger is for the normal book/inspection, not a single fictitious replacement reviewId.

evidenceLevelRuleAnchors.meaning: E0 is unanchored opinion/hypothesis; E1 is an anchored observation in an identified artifact. A pure fingerprint update creates neither a scientific observation nor a review.
Both E0 and E1, G0 and G1 are valid v2 record values.
Current source/config validation and needs_human_review+ai_candidate or approved+human determine P-ready; there is no E1/G1 minimum test.
